detail.name: Hoshimi Miyabi's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Hoshimi Miyabi's Mindscape: Martial Discipline
detail.desc2:
A card with the image of HSO Section 6's Chief printed on it.
Completely useless when actually trying to get in contact — after all, communication from within Hollows is difficult — this card is, nonetheless, an immense honor to possess. Both sides are imprinted with elegant and ancient-looking patterns, but the image doesn't seem to have anything to do with the Hoshimi family.
